text:
olivia: Heads up — after toggling the pricing-experiment yesterday we ran the prorate repair job and I'm seeing duplicated prorated credit lines on ~57 invoices in Stripe, but NetSuite shows only one credit or none for some. Ledger mismatch.
olivia: Example stripe event: 
```
{ "type":"credit_note.created", "id":"cn_2KZ...", "invoice":"in_3AB...", "lines":[{"amount":-1200, "description":"proration adjustment"}], "metadata":{"proration_job":"prorate-repair-2026-03-21"}}
```
mark: Did the repair job call the standard webhook path or did it call the stripe api directly?
priya: It runs a worker that calls stripe.creditNotes.create() for each invoice. We added a retry wrapper when we saw transient 409s, but the retry logic doesn't set an idempotency key — only relies on retries at the job layer.
stripe-bot: automated: credit_note.created x57 (job=prorate-repair-2026-03-21)
cfo: Finance sees a sudden dip in AR and a bunch of statement credits. We need the full list and amounts before telling customers. Do not issue refunds.
netsuite-bot: import: processed=42 skipped=15 reason=missing_tax_code
ops: NetSuite import logs show two failure modes: (1) some credit_notes never hit the importer (they were created with metadata.source=repair-job and importer filters for source=webhook or source=manual); (2) several imports failed because tax_code was null for the proration line and NS requires a taxcode for credit memos.
olivia: So duplicates in Stripe + importer rejecting some due to missing tax_code. Ugh.
mark: Short term: pause the repair worker. Run dedupe on Stripe: group by invoice_id and keep earliest credit_note id. Add idempotency key on retry and a DB recorder row for created credit_notes.
priya: I'll add a tiny change — include header Idempotency-Key: invoice-{invoice_id}-prorate when calling stripe in the worker and write to a local table created_credit_notes(invoice_id, credit_note_id, job_id). Will open PR now.
mark: Also for NetSuite: update importer to accept metadata.source in (webhook,repair-job) for controlled runs, and require tax_code fallback to the invoice line's tax code if present. But only after we confirm no duplicates.
netsuite-bot: ingestion: re-run dry-import on flagged set (42) - reporting to follow.
ops: Action plan: 1) pause repair worker (kubectl scale deployment prorate-repair --replicas=0 -n prod) 2) dedupe stripe credit_notes: SELECT invoice_id, array_agg(id ORDER BY created_at) FROM stripe_credit_notes WHERE metadata->>'proration_job'='prorate-repair-2026-03-21' GROUP BY invoice_id HAVING count(*)>1; 3) produce CSV for finance 4) run dry-import after importer whitelist change.
olivia: CSV will help CS too. Mark, Priya — can you post the CSV in drive.redwood.com/finance/prorate_duplicates_2026-03-21.csv once ready?
priya: Will do. PR for idempotency header opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4589 — includes unit test and staging run.
mark: Finance note from CFO: do not reconcile or post reversing entries until we confirm NetSuite has ingested one canonical credit per invoice. Manual adjustments will cause double-counting.
ops: Also adding a short-term net: when importer skips for missing tax_code, it should emit a CSV with invoice_id, credit_note_id, line_index, reason so finance can triage. Ticket FIN-2026-21 filed.
olivia: Thanks. Keeping this P0 for now. I'll coordinate CS message after we have the CSV and the reconciliation guidance for customers.
priya: Uploaded CSV: drive.redwood.com/finance/prorate_duplicates_2026-03-21.csv
mark: Confirmed duplicates for 57 invoices, 12 had missing tax_code causing NetSuite rejects.
cfo: Good work. Once dedupe script is applied and importer fixed, we can re-import. Keep me posted before any ledger postings.
